metadata.compliance: Built for NASA Space Apps Challenge using NASA Open Data. No official NASA insignia used per NASA Media Usage Guidelines.
primary_sources: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) - LOLA, Diviner, LROC
NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) - HiRISE, CRISM

sites.name: Lonar Crater, Maharashtra, India
sites.traits: Formed in Deccan basaltic rock, mirroring lunar mare impact craters in mineralogy and ejecta structure.
sites.testing: Crater wall rover traversal, basaltic regolith drilling, and impact geology.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA LRO LOLA Elevation & LROC Imagery (PDS)

sites.name: Haughton Crater, Devon Island, Canada
sites.traits: Sub-zero temperatures, rocky impact breccia, and low-angle polar sunlight mirror Artemis Lunar South Pole landing zones.
sites.testing: Pressurized rover operations, spacesuit mobility, and subsurface ice extraction.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer & LOLA Polar Data

sites.name: Craters of the Moon, Idaho, USA
sites.terrain: Basaltic Lava Flows & Subsurface Lava Tubes
sites.traits: Intact volcanic lava tubes provide natural shielding against cosmic radiation and micrometeorites.
sites.testing: Autonomous cave mapping drones and permanent underground lunar habitat modules.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA GRAIL Gravity Data & LRO Terrain Camera

sites.name: Mauna Loa / PISCES, Hawaii, USA
sites.traits: Glass-rich volcanic ash closely replicates abrasive, electrostatically charged lunar dust.
sites.testing: In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU), robotic landing pad sintering, and dust seals.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA Artemis Lunar Regolith Simulant & LRO Spectral Profiles

sites.name: Tso Kar & Ladakh, India
sites.terrain: High-Altitude Cold Desert & Evaporite Salt Flats
sites.traits: Thin dry atmosphere, high UV radiation, and saline permafrost mirror ancient Martian lakebeds.
sites.testing: Astrobiology biosignature detection, extreme cold habitat insulation, and rover endurance.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA MRO CRISM Mineralogy & NASA Earthdata

sites.name: Atacama Desert, Chile
sites.traits: Near-zero rainfall, intense UV flux, and perchlorate-rich soils match Martian surface chemistry.
sites.testing: Autonomous life-detection rovers and deep subsurface regolith drills.
sites.nasa_dataset: NASA Curiosity SAM & MRO HiRISE Imagery
